page.overview:
What is Balamb Garden?

Balamb Garden is a town located in the skies of Grymoire in World of Final Fantasy. It is the base of operations for the League of S. It is first visited in Chapter 20, "The Crimson Prophecy's End".

{|class="article-table WoFF full-width" style="text-align:center;"

!style="width:30%"|Items !style="width:30%"|Images !style="width:40%"|Location

"Prismelody: Balamb Garden" is the background theme that plays in Balamb Garden. It is an arrangement of the song "Balamb GARDEN" from Final Fantasy VIII.
